meta.title: Progressive abdominal swelling and ankle puffiness
meta.candidate_brief: You are the medical registrar in the hepatology day unit. Take a history from this patient complaining of abdominal distension and assess complications.

patient_script.opening_statement: My belly has blown up and even my ankles are puffy.

if_asked.symptom_details: My stomach feels tight and swollen; my trousers barely fit and my ankles leave marks from socks.
if_asked.timing: Started gradually three weeks ago and has been getting worse.
if_asked.after_effects: I feel breathless when bending over and uncomfortable sleeping.
if_asked.exacerbating: Salty food and staying on my feet all day seem to make it worse.
if_asked.relieving: Lying flat with legs up helps the ankle swelling a bit.
if_asked.associated_symptoms: I've noticed needing to pee at night, some bruises on my arms, and occasional confusion in the evenings. No chest pain.
if_asked.past_medical_history: Known cirrhosis from hepatitis C, treated last year; had variceal banding previously.
if_asked.medications: Take spironolactone, furosemide, lactulose, and a vitamin supplement; sometimes forget afternoon lactulose.
if_asked.allergies: Allergic to latex; it gives me a rash.
if_asked.family_history: No liver disease in family; father had stroke at 70.
if_asked.social_history: I stopped drinking alcohol 18 months ago, used to drink heavily. I smoke 3 cigarettes a day, live with my sister, and do part-time admin work.
if_asked.functional_status: Struggling to tie my shoes and have taken sick leave because I'm so uncomfortable.

collateral.observer_note: Sister reports he has been more forgetful in the evenings.

patient_script.emotional_tone: Tired, mild shortness of breath while talking

pc.one_liner: My belly keeps swelling and my ankles are puffed up.

hpc.character: Progressive abdominal fullness with ankle edema
hpc.timing: Worse by evening, slight relief overnight

hospitalisations: Admitted last year for ascites drainage

dh.recent_changes: Dose of diuretics increased by GP last week

sh.diet: Trying low-salt diet but occasional takeaways
sh.occupation_detail: Part-time desk job, currently on sick leave

ice.ideas: Thinks fluid is building up again
ice.concerns: Worried it means his liver is failing
ice.expectations: Hopes for drainage and advice on keeping it from coming back

immediate_investigations: Blood tests including LFTs, U&E, coagulation
